differential_live_runner_plan.why: compile-only and pure payload tests cannot verify key-window focus, terminal startup/environment, lifecycle events, close history, or restart persistence
differential_live_runner_plan.canonical_fixture: Build/launch frozen canonical e1825d40 in an isolated tagged macOS app/socket. Create two windows with at least three workspaces each, one pinned workspace, one group, one layout workspace, and event stream subscription.
differential_live_runner_plan.windows_fixture: Launch the matching Windows build with an isolated named pipe and equivalent state via public v2/CLI operations.
differential_live_runner_plan.runner: A manifest-driven Python runner sends v2 JSON and invokes each CLI executable, records request/response, stdout, stderr, exit code, normalized state snapshots, event frames, selected/key window, and terminal-observed cwd/env/command. Dynamic UUID/ref fields are symbolized by creation order before comparison; arrays and text remain order-sensitive; object keys are compared as sets with exact values.
phases: read matrix across every routing selector and invalid explicit window
create matrix for cwd/command/env/layout/group/focus and terminal probe
select/rename/close across foreground/background/pinned/sole-tab cases while watching focus and events
quit/relaunch then compare list/current/title/layout/env and reopen-closed history
run six CLI verbs under empty, ambient caller, explicit window, refs, UUIDs, indexes, --json, and all id formats
differential_live_runner_plan.pass_condition: No unexplained normalized response, output, state, focus, event, or restore delta for any adversarial case

batch_assessment.reason: The six CLI verbs are direct façades over the six v2 methods and share routing/identity semantics, so the 12-entry audit batch is coherent. Implementation should be staged into the three disjoint scopes above because read routing, mutation lifecycle, and CLI normalization/output have independent red/green gates and substantially different risk.
